items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for SearchWoot public beta or full launch; conditional for ordinary reversible growth that preserves existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, platform-policy, and data boundaries. Exact decision: keep SearchWoot private and preview-only. Woot API documentation establishes access mechanics, not rights to store, derive, cache, display, alert on, or monetize deal data; public terms restrict relevant uses. Human counsel is required before any rights-dependent launch, affiliate, advertising, or external-permission decision. Technical compliance is only a baseline: 36 pass, 17 fail, 6 unknown; incomplete telemetry alone does not block ordinary growth. Revenue remains aggregate and unattributed: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission for 2026-09-21. No go-live proposal is supported.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 tasks closed and 4 remain open. No task is closed because direct evidence is incomplete. Next evidence action: attach and review one consolidated read-only bundle containing the field-level rights matrix, deployed data-flow and retention table, log/vendor/incident inventory, consent and GA4 configuration evidence, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback evidence. Keep rights outreach unsent pending human-counsel review and owner authorization.

Data-use review dispositions: Woot API deal and price-history data — blocked; missing written permission or API agreement, field-level provenance and permitted storage, derivatives, display, caching, alerts, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademark/image/price, affiliate, and advertising terms. Smallest next action: complete the internal counsel packet and obtain human-counsel review before any owner-authorized request. User alert rules and sync results — evidence_needed; missing data inventory, identifiers, retention, deletion/correction/access workflow, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior. Smallest next action: produce a read-only deployed/repository data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics — evidence_needed; missing deployed consent/withdrawal behavior, GA4 property and data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdictional review. Smallest next action: capture consent and GA4 configuration evidence without enabling new tracking. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data — evidence_needed; missing log-field inventory, retention/access controls, vendor terms or DPA coverage, incident handling, subpoena handling, and data-subject request procedures. Smallest next action: produce a read-only log, vendor, incident, and request-procedure inventory.

Concrete launch decision for complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net: keep each parked, private, and preview-only. Do not publish, deploy, alter DNS, configure analytics, monetize, spend, add dependencies, or create queue entries. Continue the existing readiness packet. Next evidence action: attach dated owner verification, preview/build evidence, compliance checklist, security evidence, measurement boundary, rollback point, and explicit blocker for each site.

Continue containment-only execution. Complete or justifiably close the retained saveusfarms.com failure by 2026-09-30T07:30:00Z. Close only with dated ownership, root-cause or close rationale, isolated validation, build/link/accessibility checks, rollback point, release/security boundary, attribution and measurement limits, and deduplication evidence. Do not retry unchanged work or create a duplicate request.
